sections.overview: A marine Liparidae snailfish recorded in the northeast Atlantic west of northern Spain.
sections.identification: Its posterior intestine forms two close parallel coils, the feature reflected in its scientific name.
sections.habitat: It is reported from deep water, but the precise living depth is not established.
sections.diet: The consulted species accounts do not describe its diet.
sections.behavior: No species-specific behavior is given in the consulted accounts.
sections.reproduction: The consulted sources contain no reproductive observations.
sections.ecology: The known record is limited, and ecological information is scarce. P. islandicus is another northeast-Atlantic congener, recorded south of Iceland; its description emphasizes pale skin and a steeply angled mouth.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports the IUCN category Data Deficient, assessed in 2014.
